business_rules:
Alert percentage thresholds constrained precisely from 0.1%
to 99.9%

Real-time monitoring and price drop evaluation runs only during US
equity market hours

Trigger debounce and cool-down resets prevent
notification spam on a daily basis

Holding liquidation (quantity reaching 0)
automatically archives any associated active AlertConfigurations

validation_results.finding:
The database schema indexes
'alert_triggers' on the configuration ID to optimize the retrieval of
'historical notification lists' for user audit logs. However, the API
specification only exposes triggers nested under a specific alert configuration
via 'GET /alert-configurations/{id}/triggers'. It does not expose a user-level
consolidated endpoint (e.g., 'GET /users/{id}/triggers') to view all recent
historical triggers across different tickers, requiring multiple separate
requests to render a notification history page.
validation_results.recommendation:
Expose a
user-level endpoint such as 'GET /users/{id}/triggers' or allow querying a root
'/triggers' resource with a 'user_id' filter to easily build historical
notification feeds in the user interface.

final_recommendation:
The architecture exhibits high cohesion and complete
structural traceability. All domain entities, lifecycle states, and database
constraints map logically through backend models and REST resources. The
low-severity suggestion to support a consolidated user trigger history endpoint
will improve API utility and performance for client audit logging.
